continuous_error_certificate.method: Convex 3D BSP subtraction of runtime hull by union of frozen reference Minkowski cube expansions
continuous_error_certificate.proof: For each original convex S, conv{v+c : v in vertices(S), c in cube corners}=S+cube. Every expanded halfspace is moved inward by 1e-7mm before BSP. Empty positive-volume remainder certifies full runtime convex-solid coverage, with lower-dimensional boundary obtained by closure. Every retained source cell is inside its hull by convex support. Thus inward material error is zero up to documented floating support tolerance, and outward material Hausdorff error <=sqrt(3)*0.005mm.
continuous_error_certificate.limitations: This certificate bounds material solids. Actual exterior/critical-surface ownership, inter-part interfaces and protected-void witnesses require the separate frozen global validation; inherited source patches are explicitly provenance, not a claim of unchanged runtime planar footprints.
continuous_error_certificate.certificate_restriction: The fixed 5um cube is a sufficient certificate stricter than the frozen 10um Euclidean critical budget. Rejected cube-cover merges do not establish that every partition meeting 10um is impossible. The single 22-entity candidate is retained as BLOCKED by four actual minimum-scale failures.

critical_working_supports.proof: Convex support extrema occur at vertices; all inherited working-face polygons lie between the reported parallel support planes. This is a working-plane certificate, not a replacement for global union-exterior distances.

critical-features.json.scope: Contact layer has root/taper notches and no bore/pocket passage. Backing and mount bore/pocket witnesses are outside this local certificate. Global exterior-surface ownership is validated by the assembler.

verification.json.volume_note: Runtime hulls can overlap. Cell-volume sums are not the runtime union volume.
verification.json.exterior_surface_note: Material inclusion does not imply reference exterior to runtime exterior distance is zero. No inward exterior claim is made here.
verification.json.witness_scope: Five complete bore axes with four offset continuous segments; nine pocket-to-mouth segments. Global eroded void-core and complete exterior bounds remain root-integration checks.

independent-geometry-verification.json.surface_distance_scope: Burial samples expose changed old exterior and cannot establish the required global bidirectional exterior bound.
independent-geometry-verification.json.microseam_policy: Reference contact504..541/backing660..697 interface wedge up to 9.005483698629191um has no independent named mechanical meaning; frozen preregistration permits absorption. Do not claim preservation of all original microseams.
independent-geometry-verification.json.protected_void_core_implication: Continuous coverage by original material plus a Euclidean <0.05mm offset excludes runtime material from EVERY reference void core eroded by 0.05mm. Explicit continuous axis witnesses independently check named passage connectivity; global assembly unions remain a separate validation.

construction.method: Deterministic same-family reference-adjacency agglomeration; subminimum inscribed diameter first; original-cell Minkowski cube continuous 3D coverage for every accepted hull.
construction.minkowski_cube: Each original cell + cube [-a,a]^3 with a=(budget-1e-5mm)/sqrt(3). Every point in the expanded cell is within budget-1e-5mm Euclidean distance of that original cell.
construction.continuous_cover: Subtract each expanded ORIGINAL convex cell from candidate hull as convex halfspace pieces. Accept only if no 3D remainder survives; no vertex-only or volume-only acceptance.
construction.unchanged_thin_material_policy: Keep and report BLOCKED; no small cell is deleted.
construction.critical_family: distal_tip_contact uses 10um solid-distance bound; root integration checks original critical normals/exterior.

summary.json.zero_inward_value_meaning: No original material is removed. This is a solid-membership statement; exterior surfaces can move outward by the nonzero terrain bound and no zero surface-distance claim is made.
summary.json.same_source_part_positive_volume_overlap: Excluded by exact projected-area conservation and unchanged terrain perimeter; numerical area tolerance 2e-8mm2 is disclosed.
summary.json.source_error_method: Complete upper-envelope/source-triangle planar subdivision, equivalent to the seed halfspace LP. Maximum vertical source advance bounds bidirectional Euclidean exterior Hausdorff distance and directed added-material distance. Inward material error is zero because every reference cell is contained in its replacement hull.
summary.json.source_error_limitations: Bounds cover this terrain source part. Whole-assembly exterior and cross-part ownership are independently evaluated by the global assembler. No physics/engine validation is performed.

protected_features.central_through_bore: Exact xz footprint including face451 wedge retained; no footprint can bridge its void.
protected_features.four_blind_recesses: All original source material retained; upper-envelope source advance <=0.01mm. The exact y=-70mm mouth section and source floor/axis depth are checked in feature-witnesses.json.
protected_features.root_slot: No merge across x=+-3.7mm ear/bridge boundaries; y=-76.5mm ears and y=-73mm bridge rear surfaces unchanged.
protected_features.assembly_side_channels: Exact assembly y=-70mm section and ear outer side coordinates retain original mount/backing annuli and side channels; global cross-part verification remains required.

construction.algorithm: Deterministic adjacent reference-cell hull agglomeration with convex projected-footprint and exact assembly-section preservation
construction.fixed_face451_rule: The owner of every nonprismatic face451 rear wedge is immutable; upper-terrain-only merge certificates cannot authorize its convexification.
construction.reference_cell_membership: Every original reference cell appears in exactly one output reference_entity_ids list.
construction.insphere_method: Maximum common slack of unit-normal hull halfspaces, solved as a four-variable linear program
construction.budget_selection: Frozen preregistration 50um general, 10um recess terrain, zero deliberate movement of protected mouths, bore projection, slot and assembly section; no budget scan

feature-witnesses.json.method: Fixed frozen-source void core and axis points, plus exact one-dimensional halfspace intervals on all four recess axes. Complementary to complete terrain error and exact section certificates.

verification_scope: Pure offline geometry; no simulator, MJCF, collision engine or physical control execution.
